[NCERT Grade11 Ch1 — Subsets of set of real numbers]
As noted in Section 1.6, there are many important subsets of R. We give below the
names of some of these subsets.
The set of natural numbers  N = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, . . .}
The set of integers
Z = {. . ., –3, –2, –1, 0, 1, 2, 3, . . .}
The set of rational numbers Q = { x : x = p
q  , p, q ∈  Z and q ≠ 0}

N  ⊂  Z ⊂ Q, Q ⊂ R, T ⊂ R, N ⊄ T.
